criteria.formula: ((revenue[latest] / revenue[latest-2]) ^ (1/2) - 1) * 100
criteria.label: Revenue CAGR (2Y from 3 FY observations)

criteria.formula: expanding: EBITDA and PAT margin both up each year; declining_or_loss: latest PAT<=0 or both margins down; volatile: direction flips with range >300 bps; else stable
criteria.label: Profit trend (EBITDA/PAT margin)

criteria.formula: ROCE = EBIT / Capital Employed, where Capital Employed = total equity + total borrowings (RHP 'Basis for Offer Price' definitions); a disclosed ROCE overrides
criteria.label: ROCE

criteria.formula: sum(CFO over the full FY observations) / sum(PAT over the same observations); a cumulative ratio, not the arithmetic mean of annual CFO/PAT ratios
criteria.label: Cash flow quality (cumulative CFO / cumulative PAT)

criteria.formula: strong: D/E<0.5 and ICR>5; ok: D/E<1; stretched: 1<=D/E<=2; weak: D/E>2
criteria.label: Leverage (D/E, interest cover)

criteria.formula: (issue price / post-issue EPS) / (median VALID peer P/E) - 1, x100
criteria.label: P/E (post-issue EPS) vs peer median
criteria.reason: no VALID peer multiple is available; valuation cannot be scored as current. Rejected peers: GPT Infraprojects Limited: STALE (peer multiple dated 2026-07-23 is beyond the 30-day staleness limit); Indian Hume Pipe Company Limited: STALE (peer multiple dated 2026-07-23 is beyond the 30-day staleness limit)

criteria.formula: issuer EV/EBITDA vs the median VALID peer EV/EBITDA; P/B if EBITDA is not meaningful
criteria.label: EV/EBITDA (or P/B) vs peers
criteria.reason: no VALID peer multiple is available; valuation cannot be scored as current. Rejected peers: GPT Infraprojects Limited: STALE (peer multiple dated 2026-07-23 is beyond the 30-day staleness limit); Indian Hume Pipe Company Limited: STALE (peer multiple dated 2026-07-23 is beyond the 30-day staleness limit)

criteria.formula: post-issue P/E / PAT CAGR (2Y from 3 FY), %
criteria.label: PEG

criteria.formula: post-issue P/E vs the median of the last 4 same-sector IPOs: cheaper below -band, richer above +band, else in_line
criteria.label: Valuation vs recent same-sector IPOs
criteria.reason: no recent same-sector IPO valuations were supplied, so the relative test cannot be evaluated

criteria.formula: fresh / (fresh + ofs) x 100
criteria.label: Fresh issue share of offer

criteria.formula: promoter_selling if any promoter/promoter-group seller sold >0; else pe_vc_exit if any PE/VC sells >=25% of its holding; else none_or_small
criteria.label: OFS seller type

criteria.formula: promoter shares sold / sum(pre-issue shares of promoter and promoter-group sellers) x 100
criteria.label: Promoter stake sold in OFS

criteria.formula: dilution_pct < 25 or use_of_proceeds_bucket == growth
criteria.label: Dilution from fresh issue

criteria.formula: blind_heavy: (gcp + unidentified acquisition)/fresh > 20%; else debt_heavy: debt repayment/fresh > 50%; else growth: (capex + R&D)/fresh >= growth_share_min_pct; else mixed_ok
criteria.label: Use of proceeds
criteria.reason: the blind_heavy test ((GCP + unidentified acquisition)/fresh > 20%) cannot be evaluated because a GCP or unidentified-acquisition amount is undisclosed. The legal maximum is not substituted, and an undisclosed amount is not read as zero, because either would let a blind-heavy offer pass the test

criteria.formula: deep_discount_12m: any placement in the 12 months before the issue open at more than 25% below the issue price; none_or_near_ipo: none, or all within near_ipo_price_pct; else in_between
criteria.label: Pre-IPO placements / discounted allotments

criteria.formula: intact: promoter lock-in in place and no early unlock of large pre-IPO holders; else weak
criteria.label: Lock-in

criteria.formula: promoter and promoter-group holding post-issue, %
criteria.label: Post-issue promoter holding

criteria.formula: clean / minor_civil / criminal_or_regulatory across promoters, directors and the company
criteria.label: Promoter track record & litigation

criteria.formula: related-party transactions / revenue, latest FY, %
criteria.label: Related-party transactions (% revenue/costs)

criteria.formula: clean_reputed: unqualified, no auditor change, no EOM; eom_only: EOM/CARO only and no change; unstable_or_repeated_eom: auditor change within 3 years or repeated EOM. A qualified/adverse/disclaimer opinion is a knockout rather than a score.
criteria.label: Auditor quality & remarks
criteria.reason: it is not established whether the auditor changed within the last three years

criteria.formula: independent_stable: independent-majority board and no KMP exit in 2 years; high_churn: >=2 KMP exits; else other
criteria.label: Board independence & KMP stability

criteria.formula: forward industry CAGR from the independent industry report in the RHP, %
criteria.label: Industry growth outlook
criteria.reason: the industry CAGR is not scorable because its scope, forecast period, source is not recorded; spec s12 requires value, scope, forecast period and source together

criteria.formula: business.moat_rating
criteria.label: Market position & moat

criteria.formula: the higher of the top-5 customer and top-5 supplier concentration
criteria.label: Customer/supplier concentration (top 5)

criteria.formula: business.visibility_rating
criteria.label: Capacity / order-book visibility

criteria.formula: market.gmp.trend
criteria.label: GMP trend (sentiment only)

criteria.formula: market.regime.nifty_trend
criteria.label: Market regime

criteria.formula: market.subscription.overall_x
criteria.label: Overall subscription at close

criteria.formula: market.subscription.nii_x
criteria.label: NII subscription at close
